title: CREDENCE: Evaluation of the Effects of Canagliflozin on Renal and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Participants With Diabetic Nephropathy
condition: type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease

criteria.sentence: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with a hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) greater than or equal to (>=) 6.5 percent (%) and less than or equal to (<=) 12.0%, with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of >= 30 milliliter (mL)/minute (min)/1.73meter (m)^2 and less than (<) 90 mL/min/1.73 m^2

Participants need to be on a stable maximum tolerated labeled daily dose of an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEi) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) for at least 4 weeks prior to randomization

rule.unevaluable_reason: Needs a stable maximum dose held for 4 weeks; the synthetic data has no doses or dates
rule.label: Stable max-dose ACE inhibitor or ARB for 4+ weeks

criteria.sentence: Must have a urine albumin to creatinine ratio (UACR) of greater than (>) 300 milligram (mg)/gram (g) and <= 5000 mg/g

rule.unevaluable_reason: UACR is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: UACR > 300 and <= 5000 mg/g

criteria.sentence: History of diabetic ketoacidosis or type 1 diabetes mellitus

rule.unevaluable_reason: Diabetic ketoacidosis history is not in the synthetic records, so this either/or cannot be decided
rule.label: Exclude diabetic ketoacidosis or type 1 diabetes

criteria.sentence: History of hereditary glucose-galactose malabsorption or primary renal glucosuria

rule.unevaluable_reason: Glucose-galactose malabsorption and renal glucosuria are not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Exclude glucose-galactose malabsorption or renal glucosuria

criteria.sentence: Renal disease that required treatment with immunosuppressive therapy

rule.unevaluable_reason: Immunosuppressive treatment history is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Exclude renal disease treated with immunosuppressants

rule.unevaluable_reason: Liver disease is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Exclude significant liver disease

criteria.sentence: Current or history of New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class IV heart failure

rule.label: Exclude NYHA Class IV heart failure

criteria.sentence: Blood potassium level >5.5 millimole (mmol)/liter (L) during Screening

rule.unevaluable_reason: Blood potassium is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Exclude potassium > 5.5 mmol/L
